licence.renewalWindow.value: Renew on or before the expiry date. No earliest renewal date stated. Some amendment requests at renewal (activity or licence type change, adding or cancelling a licence, lease upgrade or downgrade) are only accepted 60 days before licence expiry.

licence.afterExpiry.value: No grace period after expiry. A daily late penalty runs from the expiry date. On the 30th day after licence expiry, sponsored visas are marked absconded and the company and its owners are marked absconded. The company's registration records and all licences are struck off 6 months after licence expiry. Using a facility without a valid licence or lease draws a warning to renew within 5 working days, then a second warning within 3 working days with suspension or partial block of the facility.
